title_en: Mou Trust Company v. He Jie et al. — enforcement appeal of contract dispute
ruling_gist_en: In the execution procedure, if the execution proceeds have not yet been fully distributed, the execution procedure is not yet concluded, and creditors may apply to participate in the distribution in accordance with the law. Where other creditors of the judgment debtor believe that the judgment debtor's property is insufficient to satisfy all claims, they are entitled to file an application for participation in distribution with the enforcement court. At this point, the applicant for participation in distribution should not be strictly required to know or provide sufficient evidence to prove that the judgment debtor's property is already insufficient to satisfy all claims. The enforcement court shall review the application for participation in distribution based on the overall circumstances of the relevant enforcement case and decide whether to grant it. If it is determined that the judgment debtor's existing property cannot satisfy all claims, other creditors' applications for participation in distribution shall be granted.

full_text_en:
A Trust Company v. He Jie, et al. — dispute over enforcement of contract

【Ruling Gist】

During enforcement proceedings, if the enforcement proceeds have not yet been fully distributed, the enforcement proceedings are not yet terminated, and creditors may legally apply for participation in distribution. Where other creditors of the judgment debtor believe that the debtor's property is insufficient to satisfy all claims, they are entitled to submit an application to the enforcement court for participation in distribution. In such cases, the court should not require the applicant to know or provide sufficient evidence to prove that the debtor's property is insufficient to satisfy all claims. The enforcement court should review the application for participation in distribution based on the overall circumstances of the relevant enforcement case and decide whether to grant it. If it is determined that the debtor's existing property cannot satisfy all claims, the court should grant the application of other creditors for participation in distribution.

Supreme People's Court Enforcement Ruling

(2022) Zui Gao Fa Zhi Jian No. 109

Complainant (interested party): A Trust Company. Domicile: Chengdu City, Sichuan Province.

Enforcement applicant: He Jie, male, born September 7, 1979, Han ethnicity, domiciled in Changsha County, Hunan Province.

Judgment debtor: Zhao Xinglong, male, born November 28, 1955, Han ethnicity, domiciled in Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

Judgment debtor: Zhao Ning, male, born January 17, 1981, Han ethnicity, domiciled in Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

A Trust Company, dissatisfied with the Enforcement Ruling (2021) Xiang Zhi Fu No. 15 rendered by the Hunan High People's Court (hereinafter referred to as Hunan High Court), filed a complaint with this Court. After acceptance, this Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to review the case, and the review has now concluded.

In the course of enforcing the case of He Jie v. Zhao Xinglong and Zhao Ning concerning a contract dispute, the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province (hereinafter referred to as Chenzhou Intermediate Court) sealed up and auctioned the properties located at Shenzhen City, XXX Garden (Phase I), Building XX3 and XX5 (hereinafter referred to as the properties involved), which were registered under the name of judgment debtor Zhao Ning. A Trust Company, dissatisfied, filed a written objection. On June 12, 2020, Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang 10 Zhi Yi No. 159, rejecting the objection request of A Trust Company. A Trust Company, dissatisfied, applied for reconsideration to Hunan High Court. On August 27, 2020, Hunan High Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang Zhi Fu No. 140, revoking Chenzhou Intermediate Court's Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang 10 Zhi Yi No. 159 and remanding the case for a new review. Chenzhou Intermediate Court held a hearing on November 12, 2020.

A Trust Company alleged in its objection: In the enforcement case of A Trust Company v. Dongfang Jin Yu Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jinyu Company), Zhao Ning, et al. regarding a notarized creditor's rights instrument, A Trust Company applied to Chengdu Railway Transportation Intermediate Court (hereinafter referred to as Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court) for a subsequent seizure of the properties involved. Subsequently, Chenzhou Intermediate Court, in its case (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134, conducted a public auction of the aforementioned two properties, which were sold successfully. Upon becoming aware of this, on December 23, 2019, A Trust Company applied to Chenzhou Intermediate Court for participation in distribution, while also coordinating with Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court to send a letter to Chenzhou Intermediate Court. On January 7, 2020, Chenzhou Intermediate Court replied to Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court, stating that the auction proceeds had been paid to the priority creditors and He Jie on December 16, 2019, and therefore, A Trust Company's application for participation in distribution could not be fulfilled. Based on this, A Trust Company argued that Chenzhou Intermediate Court, despite being aware that A Trust Company was a subsequent seizure creditor, failed to notify it of the distribution of the auction proceeds from the two properties, which contravened the purpose of fairness in protecting creditors under the participation in distribution system and also infringed upon the lawful rights and interests of A Trust Company. Requests: 1. Revoke the distribution of auction proceeds from the two properties under the name of judgment debtor Zhao Ning in Chenzhou Intermediate Court's case (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134; 2. Include the claims of A Trust Company in the scope of claims subject to distribution of the said auction proceeds, and re-distribute the auction proceeds.

Enforcement applicant He Jie argued: 1. The distribution plan for the funds in question had been finalized and an enforcement ruling had been issued before A Trust Company applied for participation in distribution, which did not meet the time requirement for applying for participation in distribution. 2. In the enforcement case, other judgment debtors still had substantial assets under their names that had not yet been disposed of, which did not meet the conditions for initiating participation in distribution. According to Article 508 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, only when "the property of the judgment debtor is insufficient to satisfy all claims" may other creditors apply to the people's court for participation in distribution. 3. The subject qualification of the judgment debtor in the enforcement case did not meet the conditions for participation in distribution proceedings. In case (2018) Chuan 71 Zhi No. 174, the principal debtor was Jinyu Company. Since Jinyu Company continues to exist, Zhao Ning cannot be listed as the judgment debtor for intended participation in distribution; instead, the determination of whether a creditor may apply for participation in distribution should be based on the principal debtor Jinyu Company. Furthermore, where the judgment debtor is a legal person, participation in distribution proceedings cannot be implemented.

Chenzhou Intermediate Court found: 1. In the case of plaintiff He Jie v. defendants Zhao Xinglong and Zhao Ning concerning a contract dispute, Hunan High Court on October 16, 2018, rendered Civil Judgment (2018) Xiang Min Chu No. 28, the main contents of which were: "1. Defendant Zhao Xinglong shall pay plaintiff He Jie RMB 124,320,000 and liquidated damages of RMB 24,864,000 within ten days after the judgment takes effect; 2. If defendant Zhao Xinglong fails to satisfy the debt determined in paragraph 1, defendant Zhao Ning shall bear joint and several liability for the aforementioned debt; 3. Defendant Zhao Ning may seek recourse against defendant Zhao Xinglong after assuming the guarantee liability; 4. Reject the other claims of plaintiff He Jie."

2. On April 15, 2019, Hunan High Court, based on its effective Civil Judgment (2018) Xiang Min Chu No. 28, issued Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang Zhi 4-7, designating Chenzhou Intermediate Court to enforce the case. Accordingly, on May 20, 2019, Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134, sealing the properties involved; and on December 10, 2019, issued Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134 (No. 2) and Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134 (No. 3), realizing the two properties through judicial auction on Taobao.com.

3. The Enforcement Certificate (2018) Chuan Cheng Shu Zheng Zhi Zi No. 412 issued by the Shudu Notary Public Office of Chengdu, Sichuan Province confirmed that A Trust Company held claims against Jinyu Company, Yunnan Xinglong Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xinglong Industrial), Chengdu Ruixinda Enterprise Management Consulting Co., Ltd., Zhao Ning, and Wang Yinyan, with a principal of RMB 201,800,000 plus interest, etc. A Trust Company then applied to Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court for enforcement based on the notarized certificate. During the hearing of this case, A Trust Company stated that Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court had frozen shares of Jinyu Company held by Xinglong Industrial, totaling approximately 424.13 million shares, which were the fourth sequential seizure; the relevant assets had all been used for pledge financing; it had sequentially seized (fourth in order) the two properties of Zhao Ning that were auctioned by the court in this case; sequentially seized the equity of Jinyu Company, Xinglong Industrial, Zhao Ning, and Wang Yinyan in companies in Shenzhen; and on September 11, 2018, sequentially seized (second in order) the following assets in Kunming, Tengchong, and Ruili: 1. Sequentially seized four properties of Zhao Ning in Kunming; 2. Sequentially seized the equity of Jinyu Company, Xinglong Industrial, Zhao Ning, and Wang Yinyan in companies in Kunming, Tengchong, and Ruili. In addition, other related property of the judgment debtors had also been seized.

4. On December 22, 2019, A Trust Company submitted to Chenzhou Intermediate Court by mail an "Application for Participation in Distribution," requesting to participate in the distribution of the auction proceeds from the two properties involved. On January 7, 2020, Chenzhou Intermediate Court sent a reply letter to Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court, stating that A Trust Company's application for participation in distribution could not be fulfilled.

5. On November 17, 2020, the Enforcement Division of Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued the "Explanation on the Enforcement Funds of the Two Properties in Shenzhen City, XXX Garden (Phase I), Building XX3 and XX5 in Case (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134": "In the case of the enforcement applicant He Jie v. judgment debtors Zhao Ning and Zhao Xinglong concerning a contract dispute [case No. (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134], on November 12, 2019, the two properties under the name of judgment debtor Zhao Ning (Shenzhen City, XXX Garden (Phase I), Building XX3 and XX5) were successfully sold through judicial online auction, with total auction proceeds of RMB 47,948,544. After deducting the enforcement fees and online judicial auction auxiliary fees calculated for this successful auction, the priority compensation amount from the auction proceeds was paid on December 16, 2019, to the priority creditor of the two properties, Shenzhen Branch of Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. As for the remaining amount payable to the enforcement applicant He Jie, this Court had already prepared the approval procedures for his receipt of funds, but the procedures were suspended due to the buyer raising issues regarding the payment of taxes on the auctioned properties. As of November 17, 2020, the buyer's issues regarding the payment of taxes on the auctioned properties have been resolved. Subsequently, because an outsider requested participation in the enforcement distribution and raised an enforcement objection, the remaining auction proceeds of RMB 12,095,606.6 remain deposited in this Court's enforcement funds account and have not yet been paid to the enforcement applicant He Jie."

Chenzhou Intermediate Court held that the focus of the dispute was whether A Trust Company could participate in the distribution of the auction proceeds from the properties involved. Article 508, Paragraph 1 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where a judgment debtor is a natural person or other organization, and after the enforcement proceedings have commenced, other creditors who have already obtained enforcement instruments discover that the property of the judgment debtor is insufficient to satisfy all claims, they may apply to the people's court for participation in distribution." According to the above provision, there are three conditions for participation in distribution: first, the judgment debtor is a natural person or other organization; second, the creditor applying for participation in distribution has obtained an enforcement instrument; third, the property of the judgment debtor is insufficient to satisfy all claims. In this case, A Trust Company had also seized and frozen other property under the names of numerous co-debtors in the same case, including Zhao Ning, and judgment debtors with legal person status such as Jinyu Company had not entered bankruptcy proceedings. Therefore, A Trust Company's assertion that the judgment debtor's property was insufficient to satisfy all debts lacked sufficient evidence, and the court did not support its request to participate in the distribution of the auction proceeds from the properties involved. Article 509 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "To apply for participation in distribution, the applicant shall submit a written application. The application shall state the facts and reasons for participation in distribution and the judgment debtor's inability to satisfy all claims, and shall be accompanied by the enforcement instrument. The application for participation in distribution shall be submitted after the enforcement proceedings have commenced and before the property of the judgment debtor has been finally disposed of." Therefore, an application for participation in distribution must be submitted after the enforcement proceedings have commenced and before the property of the judgment debtor has been finally disposed of. In addition, Article 28 of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where the creation, modification, transfer, or extinction of property rights is caused by a legal instrument of a people's court or an arbitration commission, or by an expropriation decision of a people's government, such rights shall take effect upon the effective date of the legal instrument or the expropriation decision." Article 7 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China (I) provides: "Judgments, rulings, and mediation statements rendered and legally effective by a people's court or arbitration commission in cases such as the partition of jointly owned real estate or movable property, which change the existing property relations, as well as auction confirmation rulings and debt-for-property settlement rulings made by a people's court in enforcement proceedings, shall be deemed to be the legal instruments of a people's court or arbitration commission that cause the creation, modification, transfer, or extinction of property rights as referred to in Article 28 of the Property Law." In this case, Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134 (No. 2) and Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134 (No. 3) on December 10, 2019. At that time, the enforcement of the properties involved was completed. A Trust Company applied on December 22, 2019, for participation in the distribution of the auction proceeds from the properties under the name of judgment debtor Zhao Ning. Therefore, A Trust Company's application also exceeded the time limit for applying for participation in distribution, and the court did not support its request to participate in the distribution of the auction proceeds from the properties involved.

Accordingly, on November 18, 2020, Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang 10 Zhi Yi No. 217, rejecting A Trust Company's objection application.

A Trust Company, dissatisfied, applied for reconsideration to Hunan High Court, requesting: 1. Revoke Chenzhou Intermediate Court's Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang 10 Zhi Yi No. 217; 2. Revoke the distribution of auction proceeds from the two properties under the name of judgment debtor Zhao Ning in Chenzhou Intermediate Court's case (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134; 3. Include the claims of A Trust Company in the scope of distribution of the said auction proceeds, and re-distribute the auction proceeds. Main facts and reasons: 1. Chenzhou Intermediate Court should not have required the company to prove that the judgment debtor could not satisfy all debts. Moreover, the property of the judgment debtor that the company had applied for the court to seize and freeze was already subject to third or fourth sequential seizures or freezes, so the company had reason to believe that the judgment debtor's property was insufficient to satisfy all debts. 2. Chenzhou Intermediate Court has not yet paid out the auction proceeds from the properties involved. According to Article 509 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the company applied to the court for participation in distribution on December 23, 2019, which was before the final disposal of the judgment debtor's property. Chenzhou Intermediate Court's determination that the application for participation in distribution was filed beyond the statutory time limit was erroneous.

Hunan High Court confirmed the facts found by Chenzhou Intermediate Court. It additionally found that on May 20, 2019, Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134, sealing the properties involved, and on November 12, 2019, successfully auctioned the above properties, with total auction proceeds of RMB 47,948,544. On December 10, 2019, Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134 (No. 2): 1. The ownership (or other rights) of the property at Shenzhen City, XXX Garden (Phase I), Building A, XX3 shall vest in the buyer Kuang Yanyin. The ownership (or other rights) of the property at Shenzhen City, XXX Garden (Phase I), Building A, XX3 shall transfer from the date this ruling is served on the buyer Kuang Yanyin; 2. Buyer Kuang Yanyin may hold this ruling to the registration authority to handle relevant property ownership transfer procedures. On the same day, Chenzhou Intermediate Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134 (No. 3): 1. The ownership (or other rights) of the property at Shenzhen City, XXX Garden (Phase I), Building A, XX5 shall vest in the buyer Peng Renya. The ownership (or other rights) of the property at Shenzhen City, XXX Garden (Phase I), Building A, XX5 shall transfer from the date this ruling is served on the buyer Peng Renya; 2. Buyer Peng Renya may hold this ruling to the registration authority to handle relevant property ownership transfer procedures. On December 16, 2019, Chenzhou Intermediate Court, through the approval procedures for the transfer of funds in the enforcement case, confirmed the distribution plan for the auction proceeds of the two properties owned by judgment debtor Zhao Ning, i.e., paying a total of RMB 35,569,391.37 to the priority creditor of the properties involved, Shenzhen Branch of Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. (the loan contract dispute cases between the bank and Zhao Ning and Wang Yinyan were filed for enforcement with the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province, case Nos. (2019) Yue 03 Zhi No. 709 and 710), enforcement fee of RMB 26,361, online judicial auction auxiliary fee of RMB 200,000, and the remaining amount to the enforcement applicant He Jie in this case. On the same day, Chenzhou Intermediate Court paid the corresponding amount to the priority creditor of the properties involved, Shenzhen Branch of Industrial Bank Co., Ltd., and issued a "Work Contact Letter" to the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court of Guangdong Province regarding the payment procedures.

Hunan High Court held that the focus of the dispute was whether A Trust Company could apply for participation in the distribution of the auction proceeds from the properties involved enforced by Chenzhou Intermediate Court.

First, Article 508 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: Where a judgment debtor is a natural person or other organization, after the enforcement proceedings have commenced, other creditors who have already obtained enforcement instruments discover that the property of the judgment debtor is insufficient to satisfy all claims, they may apply to the people's court for participation in distribution. Zhao Ning, as one of the judgment debtors in case (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134 filed by Chenzhou Intermediate Court for enforcement, had the properties involved in this case auctioned and disposed of, which were only part of his property. Moreover, in the case where A Trust Company applied to Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court for compulsory enforcement based on the Enforcement Certificate (2018) Chuan Cheng Shu Zheng Zhi Zi No. 412 issued by the Shudu Notary Public Office of Chengdu, Sichuan Province, Zhao Ning was only one of the judgment debtors. A Trust Company had taken measures to seize and freeze not only other property under the name of Zhao Ning other than the properties involved in this case, but also property under the names of other judgment debtors. That is, the properties involved in this case, disposed of by Chenzhou Intermediate Court, were neither all nor the main property of judgment debtor Zhao Ning, and Zhao Ning was only one of A Trust Company's debtors; A Trust Company could still assert claims against other debtors. Therefore, this court did not accept A Trust Company's assertion that the judgment debtor's property was insufficient to satisfy its debts.

Secondly, Article 509, Paragraph 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "An application for participation in distribution shall be filed after the commencement of the execution proceedings and before the completion of the execution of the property of the person subject to execution." In this case, the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court executed the real property under the name of the person subject to execution, Zhao Ning, through judicial auction, and on December 10, 2019, issued Enforcement Rulings (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134-II and (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134-III, confirming the auction transaction. On December 16, 2019, the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court completed the approval procedures for the transfer of the proceeds of the subject matter of the execution case, confirming that after deducting the case execution fees and ancillary fees for the online judicial auction, the auction proceeds of the involved property should first be paid to the applying execution creditor in another case, who was the holder of the priority right to repayment in the involved property, namely, Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Branch, for the corresponding amount, and the remaining amount should be paid to the applying execution creditor in this case, He Jie, and on the same day, the procedures for payment to Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Branch were conducted. It should be considered that on December 16, 2019, the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court completed the approval procedures for the transfer of the proceeds of the subject matter of the execution case, and the time node at which payment was made to the priority creditor was the time of the court's decision on the distribution of the execution proceeds in this case. Although the remaining auction proceeds had not yet been paid to the applying execution creditor in this case, He Jie, at that time due to the purchaser's issue regarding the payment of taxes and fees for the auctioned property, the original distribution plan remained valid and did not affect the priority interest in the order of distribution of He Jie, the applying execution creditor in this case, as a creditor entitled to receive the proceeds at that time node, and it also conformed to the principle of civil execution that should prioritize the protection of the interests of the party who first asserted its rights. Since the trust company submitted by mail the Application for Participation in Distribution to the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court on December 22, 2019, which was after the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court had made a decision on the disposal and distribution of the proceeds in this case, its request to participate in the distribution of the auction proceeds of the involved property should not be supported.

Accordingly, on March 11, 2021, the Hunan High People's Court issued Enforcement Ruling (2021) Xiang Zhi Fu No. 15, rejecting the trust company's application for reconsideration and upholding Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang 10 Zhi Yi No. 217 of the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court.

The trust company, dissatisfied, appealed to this Court, requesting: 1. The revocation of Enforcement Ruling (2021) Xiang Zhi Fu No. 15 of the Hunan High People's Court and Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang 10 Zhi Yi No. 217 of the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court; 2. In Case (2019) Xiang 10 Zhi No. 134, the inclusion of the trust company's creditor's rights within the scope of distribution of the case proceeds and the preparation of a distribution plan. The main facts and reasons were: 1. The deadline for filing an application for participation in distribution is "before the completion of the execution of the property of the person subject to execution," which should be understood as the time when the property of the person subject to execution has completed all execution procedures, and in this case, it should be when the execution proceeds have been actually paid to the applying execution creditor; after the auction of the involved property was concluded, part of the proceeds remained undistributed, and the trust company applied for participation in distribution on December 22, 2019, which clearly did not exceed the statutory deadline. 2. The Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court, on the grounds that the trust company had sealed and frozen other properties under the names of many other debtors in the same case in its execution case and that the enterprises among the persons subject to execution had not entered bankruptcy proceedings, determined that the trust company's evidence that the property of the persons subject to execution was insufficient to satisfy all debts was insufficient, which was a serious misinterpretation of the Interpretation of the Civil Procedure Law and should be corrected.

Upon review, this Court holds that the focus of the dispute in this case is whether the trust company's application for participation in distribution should be supported.

I. Regarding the issue of the deadline for a creditor to apply for participation in distribution. Article 508 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides that where the person subject to execution is a natural person or other organization, after the commencement of the execution proceedings, other creditors of the person subject to execution who have already obtained the execution basis and discover that the property of the person subject to execution cannot satisfy all claims may apply to the People's Court for participation in distribution; Article 509 provides that to apply for participation in distribution, the applicant shall submit a written application. The written application shall state the facts and reasons for participation in distribution and that the property of the person subject to execution cannot satisfy all claims, and shall be accompanied by the execution basis. An application for participation in distribution shall be filed after the commencement of the execution proceedings and before the completion of the execution of the property of the person subject to execution. Currently, the provisions of the law and judicial interpretations on the procedure for participation in distribution are that where the person subject to execution is a natural person or other organization, and its property is insufficient to satisfy all claims, creditors may apply for participation in distribution and receive satisfaction on a pro rata basis. This system design essentially has a quasi-bankruptcy function. Regarding the understanding of "filed before the completion of the execution of the property of the person subject to execution," the transfer of ownership through a ruling after the court disposes of the property concerned in the execution proceedings does not mean the conclusion of the execution proceedings. The liquidation and distribution after the conversion of immovable property into value is also one of the stages of the execution proceedings. It cannot be considered that the execution proceedings have been completely concluded simply because the ownership of the disposed property has been transferred. At this time, if the execution proceeds have not yet been fully distributed, the execution proceedings have not yet ended; that is, before the property of the person subject to execution is distributed, creditors may lawfully apply for participation in distribution.

With regard to this case, based on the facts found, on November 12, 2019, the executing court successfully disposed of two properties under the name of the person subject to execution, Zhao Ning, through an online judicial auction. On December 16, 2019, part of the auction proceeds was paid preferentially to the priority creditor, Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. Shenzhen Branch. The remaining auction proceeds had not yet been distributed due to issues raised by the purchaser regarding the payment of taxes and fees for the auctioned property. When the trust company submitted the Application for Participation in Distribution to the executing court on December 22, 2019, the proceeds from the realization of the involved property were still in the account of the executing court, the property had not yet been distributed and disposed of, and the execution had not been concluded. Therefore, the trust company's application for participation in distribution should be supported.

II. Regarding whether the trust company's application for participation in distribution should be supported when it has already frozen other property of the person subject to execution in another case. According to the provisions of Article 509, Paragraph 1 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, an applicant for participation in distribution need only submit a written application stating the relevant facts and reasons for participation in distribution and that the property of the person subject to execution cannot satisfy all claims, and attach the execution basis. During the execution proceedings, if other creditors of the person subject to execution believe that the property of the person subject to execution is insufficient to satisfy all claims, they have the right to submit an application for participation in distribution to the executing court. At this time, it should not be demanded that the applicant for participation in distribution must understand or provide sufficient evidence to prove that the property of the person subject to execution is already insufficient to satisfy all claims. The executing court shall review and decide whether to allow the application based on the overall circumstances of the relevant execution case. As long as it is determined that the existing property of the person subject to execution cannot satisfy all claims, other creditors should be permitted to apply for participation in distribution. In the case of the trust company's application for execution against Jin Yu Company, Zhao Ning, et al., Zhao Ning, as a guarantor for the debt, assumed joint and several guarantee liability for Jin Yu Company's loan of RMB 202 million. During the execution of that case, the Chengdu Railway Intermediate Court indeed took measures to seal and freeze the property of several persons subject to execution, but they were all sequential seals and freezes. Subsequently, because no executable property was found for the persons subject to execution, the case was ruled to be concluded in the current execution procedure on December 25, 2018, and has not been resumed for execution to date. The above facts sufficiently prove that the existing property of the person subject to execution, Zhao Ning, is insufficient to satisfy all claims. Therefore, the trust company's application in this case to participate in the distribution of property under Zhao Ning's name falls within the circumstances provided for by law and judicial interpretations and should be supported.

In conclusion, the trust company's reasons for appeal are valid and are supported by this Court. Enforcement Ruling (2021) Xiang Zhi Fu No. 15 of the Hunan High People's Court had unclear findings of fact and erroneous application of law, which this Court hereby corrects. By reference to Article 211 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and in accordance with Article 71 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Work of Enforcement by People's Courts (for Trial Implementation), the ruling is as follows:

1. Enforcement Ruling (2021) Xiang Zhi Fu No. 15 of the Hunan High People's Court is revoked;

2. Enforcement Ruling (2020) Xiang 10 Zhi Yi No. 217 of the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province is revoked;

3. The Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province shall review and handle the trust company's application for participation in distribution in accordance with the law.
